scripts.deps: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-store && pnpm config set store-dir /tmp/pnpm-store &&rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf pnpm-lock.yaml && rm -rf ~/.pnpm-store && pnpm store prune && pnpm install --no-prefer-frozen-lockfile
scripts.check: vp fmt --check && vp run -r check && pnpm lint
scripts.fix: vp fmt && vp run --filter './packages/*' --filter ./test fix && markdownlint-cli2 --fix && textlint --fix '**/*.md'
scripts.lint: markdownlint-cli2 && textlint '**/*.md' && cspell --no-progress --dot '**' && secretlint '**/*' && node scripts/typespec.ts && node scripts/actionlint.ts -color && node scripts/zizmor.ts .github/workflows
